Lastly, the Personal Insurance segment addresses individual needs by offering property and casualty insurance for personal risks. Its primary focus areas are automobile and homeowners insurance, which are also made available to consumers through independent agencies and brokers. Founded in 1853, The Travelers Companies, Inc. maintains its headquarters in New York, New York.
